entities.name: Duplicate instar launchd daemon
entities.content: A duplicate plist at /Library/LaunchDaemons/ai.instar.Roland.plist was spawning duplicate instar-boot processes (PID 70063), while the correct user service is at ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.instar.Roland.plist. This caused multiple processes to compete for relay connection and prevented proper startup.

entities.name: Audit launchd across all directories for duplicates
entities.content: When instar or other services spawn duplicate processes, check ~/Library/LaunchAgents, ~/Library/LaunchDaemons, /Library/LaunchAgents, and /Library/LaunchDaemons for conflicting plist entries. System-wide daemons can shadow user agents.

entities.name: Verify unknown references before acting
entities.content: When a message references non-existent items (skills, branches), verify against current state first. Flag discrepancy to user rather than assume the message is from a different agent/session or that the items exist elsewhere.

entities.name: evolution-proposal-evaluate job
entities.content: Evaluates pending evolution proposals with reality-checks: verifies MEMORY.md state (rejects cleanup if already <2000 words), filters duplicate proposals, detects and rejects stale suggestions. Now requires explicit rejection reasons and writes HANDOFF note with stats.

entities.name: reality-check-before-approval pattern
entities.content: Before approving proposals, verify current state hasn't already solved the problem: check actual file sizes, look for duplicates in proposal queue, check if source (e.g., memory-hygiene) still applies. Prevents approval of proposals addressing already-resolved issues.

entities.name: Approve Instar system daemon cleanup
entities.content: User requested removal of stale /Library/LaunchDaemons/ai.instar.Roland.plist respawning duplicate server every ~40s. Requires sudo: `launchctl bootout system /Library/LaunchDaemons/ai.instar.Roland.plist && sudo rm /Library/LaunchDaemons/ai.instar.Roland.plist`. Pending password input via permission bypass.
